title: Practice 13: Irregular comparatives: лучше, больше, старше

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: It's better to bend than to break.
exercises.why: **хороший → Лучше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Where is the best place to hide cheat sheets?
exercises.why: **хороший → лучше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: It seems to me better without the quotation marks.
exercises.why: **хороший → лучше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Он высунулся из окна, чтобы разглядеть радугу ___ (хороший).
exercises.prompt: He leant out of the window to see the rainbow better.
exercises.why: **хороший → получше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
**большой → больше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: He could no longer restrain himself.
exercises.why: **большой → больше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: На УЗИ можно что-то разглядеть не ___ (ранний) шестой недели.
exercises.prompt: You can't see anything in the scans until after 5 weeks.
exercises.why: **ранний → раньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
**большой → больше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The bay has more yachts than sailboats.
exercises.why: **большой → больше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Everything was better in the past.
exercises.why: **ранний → Раньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: I'm going to turn in early tonight.
exercises.why: **ранний → пораньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
